digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler - inbound link diffing and application
propositions: the inbound link differ is ADD-ONLY by construction and never emits removals when a link is deleted on the peer, while the outbound direction has a removal path, creating asymmetry
a link removed in Jira stays on the local rebar ticket indefinitely because no pass ever detects or reports its absence
the apply layer silently discards removal records via `action != "add": continue` at apply_inbound_records.py:560-562, so even a correct differ cannot propagate deletions
removal cannot be safely gated on `managed_refs` alone because it cannot distinguish a brand-new never-pushed local link from a link the peer deleted—both states present identically to the guards

the shipped semantics are local-wins-and-restore: a link deleted in Jira is re-added on the next pass, convergent and safe, matching ecosystem practice rather than attempting untested deletion propagation
